blocks.text: Cricket update: Smith and Cox lead England fightback after tricky first day at Lord's. Jamie Smith hits 61 and Jordan Cox adds 55 to help England fight back on day one of the second Test against Pakistan, as the hosts recover from 77-4 to close on 248-9 at Lord's.
